title: Kagamine Len — A Treasure Chest Of Fun〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: To The Gleaming Stars Halfway Through a Dream

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord
rows.Line:
“Why don't you submit already?
You have no hope of defeating me!”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord's Vassal
rows.Line: “Hehehe. Indeed. Do you not see how weak you are?”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line:
“I refuse to submit!
I carry the weight of the world on my shoulders! Losing is not an option!”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “For the sake of all who fought alongside me until now...”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “All those who placed their faith in me...”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Yes! I nailed that line like I did during practice! That just leaves...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Now I just have to magically empower the hero so that he can defeat the Demon Lord! Get ready, Len! Here I go!)

rows.Speaker: Sorceress
rows.Line:
“Hero!
Channel our thoughts! Feel our energy coursing through...! Huh...?!”

rows.Speaker: Plushie A
rows.Line: Oh no! Her wand flew away!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(She accidentally threw it...!
What do we do?!
I'm still fighting the Demon Lord...)

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord's Vassal
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah hah!
I succeeded in disarming you of your wand!”

rows.Speaker: Demon Lord's Vassal
rows.Line: “Now, my lord, crush this so-called hero! Show him how pathetic he truly is!”

rows.Speaker: Fairy A
rows.Line: “If we give her enough energy, she should be able to use magic without her wand!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Miku...?! Oh, she's trying to help Rin!)

rows.Speaker: Plushie B
rows.Line: We'll give you lots and lots of our energy!

rows.Speaker: Sorceress
rows.Line:
“Thank you all so much!
With this much energy, I won't need my wand...”

rows.Speaker: Sorceress
rows.Line:
“Now, Hero!
Channel our thoughts! Feel our energy coursing through you!”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “So much power! This is incredible...! With this, I should be able to...!”

rows.Speaker: Sorceress
rows.Line: “Now, for disarming me of my wand, here is a little payback! Take this!”

rows.Speaker: Hero
rows.Line: “Thank you all very much! We couldn't have done it without you!”

rows.Speaker: Fairy B
rows.Line: “Sorceress, we found your wand and came to deliver it... Huh?”

rows.Speaker: Fairy B
rows.Line: “What?! But we looked so hard for it...”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Geez, that was a close one...
But we managed to figure something out!)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I'm so sorry...
I caused you all a ton of trouble because I messed up...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's important to learn from your mistakes, but these things happen during live performances.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree. If anything, I'd like to praise everyone for the wonderful ad-libbing they just did.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah☆
Because shows are a team effort♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Exactly! Rin, you even threw in a good line when you zapped MEIKO in the end there!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, you did! I liked that one very much!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Anyway... I feel pretty tired, so I'm gonna head back!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Len, no.
We should give her some space.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: What happened must be bothering her quite a bit...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, she practiced that part a lot since it was sort of the Sorceress's big moment...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: True. She recited that line in a very compelling manner during practice...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which may be why she's kicking herself for what happened. I agree that we should give her some space for now.
